# Common password denylist

Derived from the SecLists top 100,000 Xato passwords under the included MIT license.
Only entries with at least 15 characters are retained; shorter passwords are rejected by policy.
Casefolded and deduplicated. This is a baseline common-password list, not a complete breach corpus.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielmiessler/SecLists/master/Passwords/Common-Credentials/xato-net-10-million-passwords-100000.txt

Retrieved: 2026-11-03
